experiment: MIND-small dev, ARIES interests/diversity/learning vs baselines

dataset.name: MIND-small
dataset.citation: Wu et al., MIND: A Large-scale Dataset for News Recommendation, ACL 2020

parameters.bootstrap_unit: user (resampled with replacement; mean over the resampled users' impressions)
parameters.tie_break: crc32('<seed>:<impression id>:<news id>') ascending, same for every system; AUC uses average ranks instead
parameters.mrr_definition: MIND: sum over clicked items of 1/rank divided by number of clicked items
parameters.aries_topics: normalised category, subcategory and TitleEntities Label of each history item
parameters.aries_weight: share of the user's history items (present in news.tsv) carrying the topic
parameters.diverse: aries.news.selection.diverse over the static ranking; topics = primary matched topic (highest weight, profile order on ties), unmatched -> 'other'; per_source=0; limit = all

learning.cadence: one pass after every dev impression, topics with new evidence only
learning.evidence: every candidate of the impression counts as shown for each topic it matches; clicked = label 1

parameters.popular: clicks on the item in train+dev impressions with timestamp strictly before the impression
parameters.recent: earliest timestamp of any train+dev impression listing the item (no publish time in MIND)
parameters.text_tokens: \w+ over aries.interests.matching.normalise(title); no stop words, no stemming
parameters.tfidf: tf raw count, idf = ln((1+N)/(1+df))+1 over all train+dev news titles, L2, cosine

bm25.avgdl: mean over dev users with non-empty history

parameters.embedding: mean of e5-base-int8 'query:' history-title embeddings vs candidate title, cosine (not run in this result unless listed in systems)
parameters.empty_history: ARIES systems score all candidates 0 (tie-break decides MRR/nDCG, AUC = 0.5); included
